description: React component 'ReportsViewer' for displaying and managing validation reports, including viewing details and downloading reports in various formats (PDF, JSON, Excel). It manages report loading, display, and interactions within a web application.

methods.name: loadReports
methods.description: Loads available validation reports, mock data in this implementation.

methods.name: viewReport
methods.description: Displays detailed view of selected report.

methods.name: downloadReport
methods.description: Handles report download in specified format (pdf, json, excel).

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats ISO date string into user-friendly format.
